keys.statement: Lower the pressure of the columns whose split improves at lower pressure, keeping each condenser above ambient temperature; this raises relative volatility and widens temperature differences for heat integration.

plain.title: Columns whose split improves at lower pressure: lower it, keeping the condenser above ambient
plain.when: Columns need high reflux and offer few heat-integration matches.
plain.do: Check each column's sensitivity to pressure. Lower the pressure where the split improves, but keep each condenser above ambient temperature.
plain.why: Lower pressure raises relative volatility and shifts column temperatures, which can widen the temperature differences for heat integration.
plain.check: In CHEPTA, scan the column pressure and record reflux, duties and condenser temperature.

decisions.obstacle: High reflux and few heat-integration matches.
decisions.mechanism: Lower pressure raises relative volatility and shifts column temperatures.
decisions.operation: Check each column's pressure sensitivity, then lower it where it helps.
decisions.expected_change: Lower reflux and better heat matches.

keys.statement: Recycle the distillates of downstream columns to an upstream column so an intermediate impurity (ethanol here) does not accumulate at their tops; the recycle rate has an optimum, since too little lets the impurity into the product and too much costs energy.

plain.title: An intermediate impurity builds up at column tops: recycle those distillates upstream, at an optimised rate
plain.when: An intermediate-boiling impurity (ethanol in the acetone-butanol-ethanol distillation of Chen et al. 2018) accumulates at the tops of downstream columns.
plain.do: Recycle those distillates to the upstream column that removes the impurity, and optimise the recycle rate.
plain.why: The impurity has no exit unless it is returned to the column that can remove it. Too little recycle lets it into the product; too much costs energy.
plain.check: In CHEPTA, scan the recycle rate and record product purity and total duty.

decisions.obstacle: An intermediate component accumulates at column tops.
decisions.mechanism: It has no exit unless returned to the column that removes it.
decisions.operation: Recycle distillates upstream at an optimised rate.
